reading: Hundreds of people have shown strong opposition to a proposed data centre.
Opponents are concerned about its potential effects on the local area.
A company wants to construct a complex on a 101-acre site in Gwynedd.
The proposed site is located between Caernarfon and Y Felinheli.
Canolfan Ddata Menai, the company, states the project could create more than 900 temporary construction roles and 200 permanent positions.
Approximately 300 individuals gathered for a rally in Caernarfon to express their disagreement.
Additionally, over 22,500 people have signed a document opposing the development.
Local resident Ernest Dyson believes the project would cause "the destruction of the most beautiful part of the Menai Strait."
He also stated that "The people of the area are custodians of it."
Local opponent Ernest Dyson highlighted the need for appropriate regulations for such large-scale developments.
He also noted Wales has a history of extractive industries that often left little benefit for communities.
Canolfan Ddata Menai claims the project will have "no undue impact" on the Menai Strait.

entries.zh-Hans: 被提议供考虑或讨论的。

entries.zh-Hans: 一组相关的建筑物或设施。

entries.pt-BR: Um grupo de edifícios ou instalações relacionados.
entries.fr: Un groupe de bâtiments ou d'installations liés.
entries.de: Eine Gruppe zusammenhängender Gebäude oder Einrichtungen.

entries.es: Un lugar donde algo está ubicado o donde tiene lugar un evento.
entries.pt-BR: Um lugar onde algo está localizado ou onde um evento acontece.
entries.fr: Un lieu où quelque chose est situé ou où un événement se déroule.
entries.de: Ein Ort, an dem sich etwas befindet oder an dem ein Ereignis stattfindet.

entries.zh-Hans: 持续很长时间或永远的；非暂时的。
entries.es: Que dura mucho tiempo o para siempre; no temporal.
entries.pt-BR: Que dura por muito tempo ou para sempre; não temporário.
entries.fr: Qui dure longtemps ou pour toujours; non temporaire.
entries.de: Lange Zeit oder für immer dauernd; nicht vorübergehend.

entries.ja: 一つの場所に集まった。
entries.es: Se reunieron en un solo lugar.
entries.fr: Se sont réunis en un seul endroit.

entries.ja: 特に、何かを支持または反対するために開催される、大規模な公開会議。
entries.ko: 특히 어떤 것에 대한 지지나 반대를 보여주기 위해 열리는 대규모 공개 모임.
entries.zh-Hans: 一次大型的公开会议，尤其指为表示对某事物的支持或反对而举行的会议。

entries.pt-BR: Uma grande reunião pública, especialmente uma realizada para mostrar apoio ou oposição a algo.
entries.fr: Une grande réunion publique, en particulier une réunion organisée pour montrer son soutien ou son opposition à quelque chose.
entries.de: Eine große öffentliche Versammlung, besonders eine, die abgehalten wird, um Unterstützung oder Opposition zu etwas zu zeigen.

entries.es: Personas que tienen la responsabilidad de cuidar o proteger algo.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas que têm a responsabilidade de cuidar ou proteger algo.
entries.fr: Personnes qui ont la responsabilité de prendre soin de quelque chose ou de le protéger.
entries.de: Personen, die dafür verantwortlich sind, etwas zu pflegen oder zu schützen.

entries.ja: 物事の行われ方を管理する公式の規則や法律。
entries.ko: 어떤 일이 수행되는 방식을 통제하는 공식적인 규칙이나 법률.
entries.zh-Hans: 控制某事如何进行的官方规则或法律。

entries.pt-BR: Regras ou leis oficiais que controlam como algo é feito.
entries.fr: Règles ou lois officielles qui régissent la manière dont quelque chose est fait.
entries.de: Offizielle Regeln oder Gesetze, die die Art und Weise, wie etwas getan wird, kontrollieren.
